current_primary_rate_tree.purpose: preflight compatibility tree before new fixed-white taxa are available

placement_tree.composition: 20 current primary species representatives plus >=2 voucher-linked samples for each of the two new fixed-white taxa
placement_tree.purpose: identity, contamination, hybrid/discordance and placement audit; not the macroevolutionary rate tree
placement_tree.required_new_taxon_concordance: samples of each proposed fixed-white taxon must show a concordant placement across primary and declared sensitivity analyses; discordance blocks promotion
placement_tree.state_counting_rule: multiple samples of one species are never counted as multiple white macroevolutionary tips

representative_selection.criterion: highest number of eligible recovered loci in the frozen/common tree matrix
forbidden_criteria: flower-colour history favoured by the sample
preferred topology beyond the predeclared placement-concordance gate
representative_selection.replicate_sensitivity: all non-primary concordant samples remain in a representative-swap sensitivity analysis

final_rate_tree.branch_length_rule: re-infer the branch-length tree from the final 22-species primary matrix; do not obtain the final rate tree merely by double-counting or collapsing replicate white samples

claim_limit: The current 20-tip compatibility tree can validate the cross-assay pipeline and provide a preflight topology, but it cannot become the final W>=5 transition-rate tree after two new white taxa are promoted unless those taxa are included and a final one-tip-per-species branch-length tree is re-inferred.
